applications.title: Shopify - Odoo Connector
applications.description: Enterprise-grade bidirectional integration connecting your Shopify store with Odoo ERP. Automate products, orders, inventory, customers and payouts in real time.

applications.title: WooCommerce - Odoo Connector
applications.description: Seamless bidirectional sync between WooCommerce and Odoo ERP. Automate product catalog, order management, inventory and customer data.

applications.title: ShipStation - Odoo Connector
applications.description: Integrate ShipStation with Odoo for seamless multi-carrier fulfillment. Automate label printing, rate shopping, return management and shipment tracking.

applications.title: Magento 2 - Odoo Connector
applications.description: Full-featured Magento 2 to Odoo integration built for enterprise. Multi-store, multi-language and B2B catalog support with real-time sync.

applications.title: PrestaShop - Odoo Connector
applications.description: Full-featured bidirectional integration between PrestaShop and Odoo ERP. Sync products, orders, customers, inventory, pricing rules, shipping carriers and financial documents in real time.

applications.title: BigCommerce - Odoo Connector
applications.description: Complete bidirectional integration between BigCommerce and Odoo. Sync products, orders, customers, categories, and inventory with AI dashboard, webhooks, and flexible field mapping.

applications.title: Amazon - Odoo Connector
applications.description: Complete Amazon SP-API integration with AI-powered automation - FBA/FBM orders, product catalog, pricing optimization, demand forecasting, smart alerts across 25+ marketplaces.

applications.title: eBay - Odoo Connector
applications.description: Manage eBay listings, orders and inventory directly from Odoo. Multi-account and multi-region support for global marketplace sellers.

applications.title: Amazon Vendor Central - Odoo Connector
applications.description: Automates the Amazon Vendor Central order cycle in Odoo, from purchase order import to ASN and invoice submission.

applications.title: Power BI Connector (OData v4)
applications.description: OData v4 feed that connects Odoo data to Power BI, Excel and any OData v4 client.

applications.title: Construction Management
applications.description: End-to-end construction project management for Odoo - BOQ, work orders, material tracking, subcontractor management and project costing.

applications.title: Hotel Management System
applications.description: Complete hotel management solution for Odoo - reservations, rooms, guests, folios, housekeeping, restaurant, services, portal booking and full analytics dashboard.

applications.title: HRMS Dashboard
applications.description: Employee attendance dashboard built natively for Odoo. Attendance calendar, check-in/check-out with live work timer, leave balances, celebrations and project tasks in one place.

applications.title: Project Cost Management
applications.description: End-to-end project cost tracking and budgeting inside Odoo. Real-time cost forecasting, resource allocation, multi-currency support and profitability reporting.

applications.title: Premium Backend Theme
applications.description: All-in-one premium Odoo backend theme with 80+ customization options, 12 color palettes, dark mode, glassmorphism, animated login, keyboard shortcuts and per-user personalization.

applications.title: Inventory Analytics Pro
applications.description: Comprehensive inventory intelligence for Odoo - health scoring, FSN/ABC/XYZ classifications, 10 report types, automated alerts, vendor scorecards and 1-click reorder with RFQ generation.

applications.title: Project & Employee Dashboard
applications.description: Real-time project analytics dashboard for Odoo with smart insights, interactive charts, team workload heatmaps, velocity tracking, quick task creation and Excel export.

applications.title: WhatsApp Messenger
applications.description: Send WhatsApp messages directly from Odoo Sale Orders and Invoices. Template messages, PDF attachments, delivery tracking, retry failed messages and full chatter integration.

applications.title: POS Product Price on Card
applications.description: Surface selling prices directly on the Odoo 19 POS product grid. Green price pills, strike-through originals, animated savings badges when a pricelist discount applies, and a per-shop on/off toggle - zero impact on the rest of Odoo.

applications.title: Odoo AI Assistant
applications.description: Natural language AI chat for Odoo - ask questions about contacts, sales, invoices, HR, inventory and more. 6 AI models, export to CSV/JSON, conversation history and role-based access.

applications.title: PSQL Delux Query Execute
applications.description: Execute PostgreSQL queries directly from Odoo backend - run SELECT, INSERT, UPDATE and DELETE queries with a powerful in-app SQL editor and result viewer.

applications.title: SDLC Financial Reports
applications.description: Custom accounting reports for Odoo - advanced financial statements, profit & loss, balance sheet, cash flow and custom report builder with export options.

applications.title: Maintenance QR Generator
applications.description: Generate and manage QR codes for Odoo maintenance equipment - quick scanning for work orders, equipment tracking and maintenance history lookup.

applications.title: Access Management
applications.description: Granular role-based access control for Odoo. Define permissions at field level, enforce security policies, maintain full audit trails and manage SSO integration.

applications.title: Asset Management
applications.description: Comprehensive asset lifecycle management for Odoo - track acquisition, depreciation, maintenance, disposal and asset transfers across your organization.

applications.title: Odoo Chatter Position
applications.description: Odoo 18 module that moves the chatter panel beside or below form views for better visibility of records.

applications.title: Odoo IP Restriction
applications.description: Per-user IP whitelisting for Odoo 18 and 19, blocking logins, API, RPC and mobile requests from unapproved networks.

applications.title: User Login Audit
applications.description: Odoo 18 module that logs every login and logout with IP address, device, session duration and active status.

applications.title: Parking Management System
applications.description: Odoo 19 parking management for live bay availability, smart allocation, employee and visitor booking, QR access, waitlists, check-in and analytics.

applications.title: POS Receipt Designer
applications.description: Design Odoo POS receipts with drag-and-drop blocks, live preview, logos and QR codes.

applications.title: BI Dashboard AI
applications.description: No-code Odoo BI dashboard builder for KPI reports, charts, analytics, custom models, drill-through, templates and Gemini AI widgets.

applications.title: PrintBridge
applications.description: Print Odoo reports, labels and attachments straight to any printer from a lightweight desktop agent. No IoT Box.

applications.title: Dashboard Ninja AI
applications.description: AI-powered dynamic dashboards for Odoo - natural language queries, smart chart recommendations, predictive analytics and customizable KPI widgets.

applications.title: DAN AI
applications.description: AI-powered document extraction platform. Drop PDFs, images or screenshots - DAN AI returns structured fields, confidence scores and exports in seconds. 21 document types, Gmail/Outlook inbox sync, REST API, webhooks.

applications.title: Conflux
applications.description: Publish, secure, monitor and scale every API from one control plane, in the cloud, on-premise or hybrid.

applications.title: AssetIQ
applications.description: Unified CAFM, CMMS and EAM platform for operations teams to run work orders, assets, facilities and field service.

applications.title: Careready
applications.description: Training and compliance platform for healthcare employers to track caregiver learning, renewals and audit records.

applications.title: Causeway
applications.description: ERP, donor CRM and HR for Indian NGOs, covering accounts, grants, programmes and staff with FCRA and 80G built in.

applications.title: Cleardue
applications.description: Cleardue's AI reads invoices and remittances, matches ERP data, and automates payables and receivables.

applications.title: Convera Chatbot
applications.description: Conversational AI for government and regulated enterprises, deployed on-premise, air-gapped or in sovereign cloud.

applications.title: Curatio
applications.description: EHR and revenue cycle platform for skilled nursing and long-term care, linking clinical records, census and billing.

applications.title: Custos
applications.description: Custos discovers every AI system in your organization and enforces policy on prompts and agents.

applications.title: Enclave
applications.description: Runs complaint management and visitor access from one platform for government offices, enterprises and campuses.

applications.title: Fiscora
applications.description: Runs the public budgeting lifecycle: operating budgets, personnel costs, capital plans and the public portal.

applications.title: Foresite
applications.description: A governed analytics platform for federal agencies, state programs and large enterprises answering to auditors.

applications.title: Limina
applications.description: Crawls, tests, remediates and monitors sites and documents against WCAG 2.1 and 2.2.

applications.title: Loquio
applications.description: Publishes agendas, minutes and meeting video for local government, searchable across the whole public archive.

applications.title: Matrica
applications.description: Moves new student enrollment and annual registration online for districts, private and charter schools.

applications.title: Migration Global Step
applications.description: Runs international hiring end to end: sourcing, AI matching, qualification recognition, visas and onboarding.

applications.title: Narratio
applications.description: Narratio turns therapy sessions into sourced progress notes, so behavioral health clinicians spend less time charting.

applications.title: Narravyn
applications.description: AI social listening and media intelligence platform for sentiment analysis and competitor monitoring.

applications.title: Praxis AI
applications.description: Education platform with four editions covering K-12 schools, colleges, tutoring centers and online course delivery.

applications.title: Provisio
applications.description: Provisio centralizes healthcare equipment planning, standards, budgets, escalation and procurement across campuses.

applications.title: Pulastya AI
applications.description: AI voice agent platform that answers inbound and outbound business calls using your own documents.

applications.title: Reservo Fuel
applications.description: Cloud fuel management for multi-site operators: inventory, dispensing authorisation, tank reconciliation and reporting.

applications.title: Rostra
applications.description: Event registration and management for school districts: forms, approvals, payments, badges and attendance records.

applications.title: Stockyard
applications.description: Procurement and inventory platform that tracks material from requisition to issue on one auditable stock ledger.

applications.title: Tractus
applications.description: Tractus gives infrastructure teams one live geospatial network to manage highways, shipping routes and ports.

applications.title: Trestle
applications.description: A PMIS for capital projects and construction programmes, covering contracts, budgets, change orders and closeout.

applications.title: Vantage Industrial Vision
applications.description: Industrial vision platform that runs edge AI on plant cameras to flag PPE breaches, defects and zone intrusions.

applications.title: Wayfare
applications.description: Commuter mobility platform for agencies and employers: trip planning, carpool matching, verified trips and rewards.
